messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

| Priority | What the Raw evidence supports |
|---|---|
| Precise modulation-quality generation/tuning for 3GPP mmWave | R&S worked with JIO and ODMs to verify 3GPP mmWave-related test items, with optimization focused on precise EVM tuning and signal integrity after signal up-conversion [67]. |
| Signal integrity after up-conversion | The same 3GPP mmWave testing evidence explicitly names signal integrity after signal up-conversion as an optimization focus [67]. |
| Support for complex end-to-end test scenarios | The CONTEST AI outlook targets automated test plan generation, smart execution of complex test scenarios, and integration with customer lab management suites [65]. |
| DUT-aware testing | The CONTEST AI outlook includes DUT management and maintenance of DUT capabilities / pics [65]. |
| Automated result and log analysis | The CONTEST AI outlook includes analyzing test case logs for objectives, pass/fail results, root cause analysis, and signaling logs for protocol-related issues [65]. |
| AI-device user-experience testing gap | Generative AI services are growing across connected devices including smartphones, AI glasses and robots, but testing solutions remain limited and mature metrics / standardized test frameworks for user experience are still lacking [68]. |
【推論】For signal generators in AI-related connected-device testing, the Raw evidence most directly points to high-quality 3GPP/mmWave signal generation that enables EVM tuning and preserves signal integrity after up-conversion, plus automation around complex test execution and analysis [65][67][68].

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Wideband baseband
- `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`；with `K515` 到 `2 Gsample`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` sample rate：`400 Hz to 600 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` RF bandwidth：`500 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `1000 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `2000 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9F` 詳細 GNSS 規格見 `GNSS simulation for Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generators specifications`，文件 `PD 3607.6896.22`。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

R&S SMW200A › Remote control、connectors 與一般資料
- Remote control interfaces：IEC 60625 GPIB IEEE-488.2、Ethernet/LAN 10/100/1000BASE-T、USB 3.0 super speed、serial RS-232 via `R&S®TS-USB1`。
- Remote command set：`SCPI 1999.5 or compatible command sets`。
- Ethernet/LAN protocols and services：VISA VXI-11、Telnet/RawEthernet、VNC、FTP、SMB。
- Front panel RF 50 Ω path A connector：3/6/7.5 GHz options 為 N female；12.75/20/31.8/40 GHz options 為 test port adapter PC 2.92 mm female；44 GHz options 為 PC 1.85 mm male with adapter；56/67 GHz options 為 1.85 mm female with wear and tear adapter。
- Front panel RF 50 Ω path B connector：3/6/7.5 GHz options 為 N female；12.75/20/31.8 GHz options 為 test port adapter PC 2.92 mm female；44 GHz options 為 PC 1.85 mm male with adapter。
- Rear panel 包含 REF IN/OUT、INST TRG A/B、USER 4/5/6、EFC、LO IN/OUT、IEEE 488、LAN、USB DEVICE、EXT 1/2、DIG I/Q OUT、HS DIG I/Q OUT 等。
- Rated power when fully equipped：`550 W measured`；with `R&S®SMW-B94L` fully equipped：`750 W measured`。
- Operating temperature range：`0 °C to +45 °C`；with `R&S®SMW-B1056`、`R&S®SMW-B1067`、`R&S®SMW-B1067N`、`R&S®SMW-B1067O` 為 `+5 °C to +45 °C`。
- Dimensions：standard `435 mm × 192 mm × 460 mm`；with `R&S®SMW-B94L` 為 `435 mm × 192 mm × 560 mm`。
- Weight：fully equipped `21 kg`；with `R&S®SMW-B94L` fully equipped `30 kg`。
- Non-volatile memory：SSD，`512 Gbyte`。
- Recommended calibration interval：`3 years`，條件 `40 h/week operation in the full range of the specified environmental conditions`。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMW200A › 基本訂購限制
依 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]] 與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

R&S SMCV100B › AWGN（`R&S®SMCVB-K62`）
- `R&S®SMCVB-K62` 可將 settable bandwidth、settable C/N ratio 或 E/N 的 AWGN signal 加到 wanted signal。
- 使用 noise generator 時，frequency offset 不能加到 wanted signal。
- Noise distribution density：Gaussian、statistical，I 與 Q 分開。
- Crest factor：`> 15 dB`。
- Periodicity：`> 3 × 10¹⁰ s`。
- C/N、E/N setting range 依 set RF level 而定：`–50 dB to +65 dB`；resolution `0.01 dB`。
- wanted signal + noise 的 sum signal PEP 不得超過 RF path 最大可用 PEP。
- Uncertainty：`< 0.05 dB measured`，條件為 system bandwidth = symbol rate、symbol rate `< 4 MHz`、`–24 dB < C/N < 30 dB`、crest factor `< 12 dB`。
- System bandwidth setting range：standard `1 kHz to 60 MHz`；with `K521` `1 kHz to 120 MHz`；with `K522` `1 kHz to 160 MHz`；with `K523` `1 kHz to 240 MHz`；resolution `100 Hz`。
